name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.FEPacking.joint_native_floor
title: Joint field and decryption cost floor for every 128-bit path partition
statement: For every ordered nonnegative width list with at least two elements totalling 128, 65536 times the adjacent-power sum plus 1024 times (2^rank - 2) reaches 2^32. This is a conditional honest-cost barrier for the literal AMVY/BKS terminal-package layout when U>=32768 and every materialized child functional key has at least 2048 bits.
